boundaries.publicApi: No partComponent/labelComponent/separatorComponent prop. Arbitrary custom layers receive whole parts, generators, separators and setCurrentPartId in declared layer order.
boundaries.raw: Computed part.data is the original input object, not a shallow clone. Extra generic fields are preserved.
boundaries.styles: Per source datum: size then color(raw) then formatter(value) then borderColor(computed part) then labelColor(part). Profile arrays are still empty at style callback time. Zero-size/zero-value/opacity0 parts still pass through all callbacks.
boundaries.labels: Default label text is formattedValue, never datum.label. enableLabel controls parent labels layer only, not custom layer part data.
boundaries.roles: Original Parts and PartLabels map every part including zero-width; Rust stage Widgets require real existing body/border/separator Marks and therefore do not claim identical per-part component eligibility.
boundaries.separators: Original horizontal computeSeparators ignores before/after enable flags; terminal separator id is none; empty parts throws TypeError even with flags off. Recorded without copying these behaviors into Rust.
boundaries.runtime: Dependency probes do not execute React/Spring scheduling, actual SVG/D3 generators, native event delivery, tooltips or arbitrary Widget lifecycle.
